itens.titulo: CVE-2026-133469: Vates Xen Orchestra Improper Validation of Specified Type of Input Vulnerability
itens.resumo: Vates Xen Orchestra contains an improper validation of specified type of input vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to bypass authentication and perform actions with administrative privileges via a specially crafted authentication token containing an empty JSON object.

itens.titulo: CVE-2025-41450: Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series Improper Authentication Vulnerability
itens.resumo: Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow an attacker to generate a web report exposing sensitive information, including internal IP addresses, usernames, and store names.

itens.titulo: CVE-2023-25914: Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series Path Traversal Vulnerability
itens.resumo: Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series contains a path traversal vulnerability that could allow an attacker to access and read underlying server system files via the XML interface.

itens.titulo: CVE-2023-25915: Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
itens.resumo: Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series contains an improper input validation vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to run arbitrary commands on the affected system.

itens.titulo: CVE-2026-133324: Mitel MiCollab Not Failing Securely Vulnerability
itens.resumo: Mitel MiCollab contains a not failing securely vulnerability in the Audio, Web and Video Conferencing (AWV) component that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to bypass authentication controls and perform unauthorized actions.

itens.titulo: CVE-2026-133275: Mitel MiCollab Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
itens.resumo: Mitel MiCollab contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability in the Audio, Web and Video Conferencing (AWV) component due to insufficient file type validation that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to upload arbitrary files.

itens.titulo: CVE-2026-133311: Mitel MiCollab Weak Authentication Vulnerability
itens.resumo: Mitel MiCollab contains a weak authentication vulnerability in the Audio, Web and Video Conferencing (AWV) component that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to access sensitive information using a specific system-generated random identifier or pre-staged content.

itens.titulo: CVE-2026-133303: Mitel MiCollab XML Injection Vulnerability
itens.resumo: Mitel MiCollab contains an XML injection vulnerability in its Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands using pre-staged malicious content.

itens.titulo: Drupal Warns of New Highly Critical Site Takeover Vulnerability Under Active Exploitation
itens.resumo: Drupal has warned of a new "highly critical" security flaw impacting Drupal core that it said has been exploited in the wild. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-136716 (CVSS score: N/A), has been described as a case of improper checking for unusual or exceptional conditions. itens.titulo: Remus malware steals Gmail messages via fake Google Sheets extension
itens.resumo: The Remus infostealer is stealing Gmail messages through a stealthy malicious Chrome extension, a capability the malware operators marketed as a zero-day exploit in Google's email service. [...]

itens.resumo: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Wednesday added 10 security flaws to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, including five vulnerabilities impacting Mitel MiCollab that were disclosed last week. itens.titulo: 1Password customer data stolen after employee GitHub account breach
itens.resumo: 1Password has disclosed a data breach after a an employee's corporate GitHub account was hacked and used to deploy malicious code to the company's backend services to steal customer data. [...]

itens.titulo: Fake paid expert interviews impersonate brands to steal Google logins
itens.resumo: An ongoing phishing campaign dubbed "GoodGuys" impersonates major brands, including Google, Nvidia, Accenture, and SpaceX, to steal corporate Google and Okta credentials using fake invitations to paid expert interviews and webinars. [...]

itens.titulo: Italy and Switzerland warn of autonomous AI-driven cyberattacks
itens.resumo: Swiss and Italian cybersecurity agencies are warning about automated cyberattacks powered by AI agents targeting organizations in the critical infrastructure sector. [...]

itens.titulo: SYS010 malware abuses browser management to spy on Gmail, Outlook
itens.resumo: A new version of the SYS01 infostealer malware delivered through Meta ads is enrolling browsers into enterprise-style management to force the installation of an extension that steals sensitive data, including Gmail and Outlook emails. [...]

itens.resumo: Popular password management software 1Password on Wednesday disclosed a security incident involving its backend systems that led to the unauthorized access of some customer information, but emphasized that customer password vaults and other secrets were not accessed.
